name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 11, 2010
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Sister Maureen Brown, Church of Saint Thomas More
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of the Fair Housing Poster Contest Winner Awards.
P2.
Presentation of the Greater Vista Fire Safe Council Grant Funding for Fire Station One Landscaping.
P3.
Presentation of Letters of Commendation to Fire Battalion Chief Rick Minnick and Deputy Fire Chief Don Shellhammer recognizing their graduation from the pilot class of the Executive Fire Chief Course conducted by the Regional Training Center of San Diego.
P4.
Proclamation declaring May 21, 2010, "Bike to Work Day" in the City of Vista.
P5.
Presentation of "Art in Vista" Film by Charles Bronson.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending March 31, 2010 (CC)
C4.
Amendment to the As-Needed Civil Design Consulting Services Agreement (CC)
C5.
2010-2015 Regional Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing (CC)
C6.
Collection of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges 2009/10 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent solid waste charges; and
2.
Set June 22, 2010, as the date of the Public Hearing to levy assessments on the 2010/11 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2009/10 mandatory trash charges.
C7.
Conflict of Interest Code (CC/BSD)
C8.
Debt Collection Ordinance (CC)
C9.
Extension of Hours for Unleashed Dogs within South Buena Vista Park (CC)
C10.
Second Reading of Ordinance (CC)
C11.
Purchase of a Sewer Rodder Machine (CC)
C12.
Amending Voting Requirements for Municipal Ordinances (CC)
C13.
Urban Greening Program Grant Application (CDC)
C14.
Vista Brownfields Opportunities Project (CDC)
C15.
Construction Management Services (CC)
C16.
Social Host Special Event Banner (CC)
C17.
Business License Schedule - Change in Renewal Date (CC)
1.
City Council Ordinance 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 5, Chapter 5.04, Sections 5.04.020 and 5.04.270 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Payment of Business License Tax";
2.
City Council Ordinance 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 5, Chapter 5.16, Section 5.16.040 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Term of Bingo Licenses";
3.
City Council Ordinance 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 5, Chapter 5.24, Section 5.24.120.D of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Termination of Cabaret and Public Dance Hall Licenses;
4.
City Council Ordinance 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 5, Chapter 5.52, Section 5.52.020.I of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Ice Cream Vendor Permit";
5.
City Council Ordinance 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 8, Chapter 8.24, Section 8.24.050.A of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Food Vending Vehicles Permit";
6.
City Council Ordinance 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 8, Chapter 8.70, Section 8.70.090 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Term of Private Ambulance Permit"; and (Recommendation continued on following page)
7.
City Council Ordinance 2010- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 3, Chapter 3.56, Section 3.56.060.B of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Term of Tobacco Retail License."
C18.
2010-2011 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Annual Action Plan (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving the 2010-2011 CDBG Public Services Program funding allocation to The Angel's Depot and Vista Community Clinic; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving the 2010-2011 Annual Action Plan, with the exception of the funding allocation for The Angel's Depot and Vista Community Clinic, authorizing the submittal of the Plan to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, and authorizing the City Manager to approve and execute all documents related to the implementation of said plan.
C19.
South Santa Fe Avenue Drainage Project (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving a third amendment to the agreement with Tory R. Walker Engineering, Inc. for the South Santa Fe Drainage Project, approving a first amendment to the reimbursement agreement with the Community Development Commission, and making findings regarding the payment by the Community Development Commission of certain costs related to public improvements for the benefit of the Vista Redevelopment Project Area; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , approving an amended reimbursement agreement between the Commission and the City of Vista for the design of public improvements located in the Vista Redevelopment Project.
C20.
Property Acquisition of 123-219 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Resolution No. 2010- , approving a revised Purchase and Sale Agreement for the property located at 123-129 S. Santa Fe Avenue, and authorizing the Chairperson to execute the agreement; and (Recommendation continued on following page)
(Recommendation continued from previous page)
2.
Adopt Community Development Resolution No. 2010- , amending the Operating Program Budget for the FY 2009/10.
C21.
Vista City Maintenance Association (VCMA) 2010-2012 Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) (CC)
C22.
Senior Nutrition Center Meal Agreements (CC)
C23.
Land Acquisition of 1234 S. Santa Fe Avenue and Acquisition and Relocation Agreement for 321 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , approving a Purchase and Sale Agreement for the property located at 1234 S. Santa Fe Avenue, and authorizing the Executive Director to execute any and all documents and take any necessary actions to implement the transaction;
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , approving an Acquisition and Relocation Agreement for the property located at 321 S. Santa Fe Avenue, authorizing the Chairperson to execute the agreement, and authorizing the Executive Director to execute any and all documents and take any necessary actions to implement the transaction; and
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- , amending the FY 2009/2010 Operating Program Budget. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Recreation and Community Services Facility Rental and Program Fees (CC)
D2.
Fiscal Year 2009/10 Third Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive and file the FY 2009/10 Third Quarter Financial Report; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , amending the Operating Program and Capital Improvement Program Budgets for FY 2009/10 Fiscal Year.
D3.
Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2010-2011 through FY 2014-2015 (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2010- ;
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2010- ; and
3.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2010- .
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Solid Waste Franchise Fee Increase (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony, close the public hearing, and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving the Solid Waste Franchise Fee increase.
PH2.
Building Plan Check/Inspection and Traffic Impact Fees (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public testimony, close the public hearing;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving revisions to the building plan check and inspection fees; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2010- , approving a 25 percent reduction in the Arterial Street Improvements and Traffic Signal Development Impact Fee.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
ADJOURNMENT
